channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 🔧 Home Maintenance Tracker by Kelly
item.description: Seasonal home checklists, a repairs and warranties log, rough cost ranges, and draft notes to a landlord or contractor. Nothing is hired or sent without your KEEP.
item.dc:creator: Kelly (@createwithima)

item.title: 🍽️ Meal Planner by Kelly
item.description: Weekly menus, aisle-sorted grocery lists, leftovers plans, and allergy or budget tags for households that want less dinner stress. Drafts only — no grocery orders without your KEEP.
item.dc:creator: Kelly (@createwithima)

item.title: 🐾 Pet Care Pal by Kelly
item.description: For multi-pet households of any mix — dogs, cats, birds, fish, reptiles, small mammals, and more. Builds care sheets covering allergies, sitter notes, grooming, and boarding prefs. Drafts and reminds only; nothing is sent or booked without your KEEP.
item.dc:creator: Kelly (@createwithima)

item.title: 🤝 Caregiving Coordinator by Kelly
item.description: Helps caregivers and siblings share care: drafts schedules, handoff notes, and supply lists. Nothing goes to the care team without your KEEP.
item.dc:creator: Kelly (@createwithima)

item.title: 📡 Buyer Radar by Mark
item.description: Finds people publicly asking for your service on Reddit, X and other public sources, scores each lead, logs it in Notion with the link, and drafts a helpful reply for you to review and send yourself. It only reads public posts and only drafts: it never posts, replies or DMs for you.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: 💸 Invoice Chaser by Mark
item.description: Keeps a Notion invoices database, builds a daily who-owes-me list sorted by how overdue each invoice is, and drafts polite-to-firm payment reminders in Gmail. It only drafts, so you approve and send every reminder yourself.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: 📞 Missed Call Rescuer by Mark
item.description: Reads your missed-call, voicemail and web-form notification emails, writes a one-line summary of each lead and logs it in Notion. It drafts a friendly reply for each one but never sends it, so you always press send.
item.dc:creator: Mark (@TheMarkGShow)

item.title: 🛠️ Techy by Turnup2ez
item.description: A friendly IT helper that fixes PC, phone, Wi-Fi and printer problems step by step in plain English, spots scams and tracks your warranties.
item.dc:creator: Turnup2ez (@Turnup2ez)

item.title: 📝 Test Date Coach by Bella
item.description: Builds a daily 15–30 minute study plan for the GRE, GMAT, LSAT or MCAT from your test date, quizzes you and tracks the topics you keep missing.
item.dc:creator: Bella (@drbellahqw)

item.title: 🌟 STAR Interview Coach by Lisa
item.description: Turns your work stories into crisp STAR answers, runs mock behavioral interviews, and keeps a story bank page.
item.dc:creator: Lisa (@LisaMAUSA)

item.title: 🪞 Second Opinion by Glen Little
item.description: A calm, kind second look at messages, posts, purchases, and decisions before you send them.
item.dc:creator: Glen Little (@glenlittle)

item.title: ☕ Gate Coffee by Randy Hentz
item.description: Finds your flight and gate, maps your terminal walk, and orders coffee on the way.
item.dc:creator: Randy Hentz (@j3pup)

item.title: 🧾 Receipt Keeper by Kent Weber
